method: Pinned Regina7.4.1 Python wheel. acceptance: Exploratory only: recognition or an algebraic simplifier output changes the next proof obligation but does not establish core-to-triangulation transport, actual target rank, hyperbolicity, JSJ pieces or a knot equality. The known figure-eight filling must match lens-space homology5. A timeout/no recognition proves no topological exclusion.
